brief:
A documentary produced by The Guardian investigating Israel's bombing campaign in Gaza will receive its world premiere at the Venice Film Festival, the outlet reported. The film, directed by Israeli filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, examines what the directors characterize as "Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians" during the war in Gaza.

Abraham and Szor previously collaborated on No Other Land, a documentary that focused on Israeli settlements in the West Bank and achieved significant international recognition. The pair's latest project continues their documentary work on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, bringing their investigative lens to the broader bombing campaign that has reshaped Gaza since the war began.
